d: THE SIGNALBEARERS #2 — Echoes at Velnara Prime. Kaaphoria races toward the Shattered Relay, light-bending flaring. Starring Kaaphoria (Misha Zewen), Sylthune (Qufaro Fenhal), Thallitha (Riston Iwick). A team of cosmic guardians keeps the beacon-network of the far colonies lit — and something out in the dark keeps trying to snuff it.
